question: What do Burp's Params, Edited, Extension and Title history columns compute exactly (Params: any request parameter?; Edited: request modified in intercept?)
probes: Populate Burp history, read the column help and the shipped docs
Decompile the history table model with the remapped jar
resolution: RESOLVED 2026-11-15 to the extent the jar exposes. Burp side (decompiled burp.Zxwu lambdas): Params = Zb14.ZP() boolean (Zxwu.java:106-109); Title = Zb14.Zs string, null rendered empty (Zxwu.java:89-92); MIME type = Zmlg.ZI(Zb14.ZU) (:94); status/length = integer fields Zd/Zl (:98-103). Zb14 is the log-entry model; Extension and Edited columns are NOT in the Zxwu class (they come from other model classes) - their exact Burp computation remains ungrounded and is recorded as a new probe. WebProbe side (app/src/net.rs derive_history_fields, net.rs:1189-1216): params = true when the query string is non-empty OR the body is application/x-www-form-urlencoded non-empty OR a Cookie header is present; extension = lowercase suffix after the last dot of the path (empty when none); title = first <title>...</title> inner text of an HTML response, trimmed; edited = was_edited flag now WIRED 2026-11-15: intercept_request returns whether the user changed the buffer (edited.as_bytes() != original, net.rs:1779-1786) and record() stamps it on the history row (record signature net.rs:1223, entry net.rs:1260) - previously the Edited column could never be true because record had no such parameter; that was a real defect fixed this wave. Suite green: test result: ok. 223 passed; 0 failed; finished in 149.03s.
